description:
Have you seen the other side of the glowing moon?

We are C-Moon, we stand as a Crescent Moon. Glowing as a collection of curiosity and innovation. We believe that great solutions have always stemmed from even the slightest spark! As we orbit the heavenly bodies along with NASA, we will make sure that you get to see young talent, see collaboration, see a generation of innovators and C-Moon.

Keep glowing, C you in the other side! 🌙
